Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: Relied on a search snippet that showed Edwin L. Marin’s birth year as 1901 instead of verifying the actual Wikipedia page content (which lists 1899), introducing a contradictory data point that could have led to an incorrect comparison. Although later corrected, this was the first instance of erroneous data extraction.
